name: IVR
tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport Representation
hero_kpi_rationale: Organisation à caractère non-commercial sans données financières publiées. Le KPI retenu (participation au congrès annuel) reflète l'engagement et la portée internationale de l'organisation auprès de ses parties prenantes.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from multiple countries.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 different countries at the 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17, 2024).
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress, held May 15-17 in Frankfurt am Main, welcomed 225 participants from 11 different countries. This represents a key annual engagement metric for the international inland waterway transport association.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium event.
kpis.signal: Approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany attended the first Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp on November 4, 2024.
kpis.description: The inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium was held on November 4, 2024, in Antwerp with approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany. The event focused on technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.

kpis.explanation: Number of countries represented among IVR member organizations.
kpis.signal: 11 different countries represented at the 2024 Annual Congress, demonstrating the international scope of the association.
kpis.description: IVR maintains representation from 11 different countries across its membership, reflecting its pan-European mandate for inland waterway transport representation.
